messages.subject: col_labs in ezPlot?
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
I'm using ezPLot and was searching how can I change the col variable level names.
I understand how to change the split and the dv but didn't find the option to do so on the columns.
Thank you very much,
Or.

plotting by changing the factor level labels.
